fit_reason: Private-owner listing for a complete 2013 BMW 328i xDrive sedan, a car we can detail.
findings: Black paint on the hood and sides looks glossy and reflective overall, consistent with the ceramic coating the seller mentions
Light dust and pollen film visible on the hood and front fenders in the angled sun shots
Headlight lenses look slightly hazy compared to the rest of the front end
Wheels look reasonably clean but with light brake dust on the front wheel faces
Interior is not clearly shown; only seat tops visible through the glass
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 328i and it looks like it has been well kept. The black paint shows a bit of dust on the hood in the photos, and the headlight lenses look like they could be a touch clearer. We do pre-sale details that come to you, including a coating-safe wash, headlight restoration and an interior wipe-down. Would you like a quote?
